scope: Four personal-name tablet citations in Surdi and De Graef 2025 note22; not the note's two village/granary citations or all Meluhha references
timing: Frozen after prior P453801/P516366 review and identification of P516138, before results of the remaining two artifact reviews; not a preregistration of the whole research project
eligibility_requirements: A readable Indus sign sequence on an authenticated object or impression
A separately readable personal name with source and transcription uncertainty retained
Independent evidence identifying whose name is represented by that specific Indus sequence; recipient status alone does not qualify
Physical-object and repeated-seal identity reviewed independently of publication/database IDs
missing_evidence_policy: Unknown is retained as unknown; it prevents admitting a name anchor but is not a negative observation about the ancient artifact
duplicate_policy: Report publication and database counts separately; do not claim independent witnesses for the P453801/P516366 possible-duplicate pair
phonetic_test_policy: Only an admitted externally attributed Indus sequence can be used to test a fixed key; resemblance searches in an unattributed name pool cannot establish the mapping
outputs: Per-record export audit, manual primary-image/context reviews, finite-pool synthesis and explicit remaining missing evidence
